title: Warqee Lafa Onaa Keessatti Xuxxuqee
intro: Yeroo eegaa fi mirkanaa’uu dhabuu keessatti buufata gammoojjii bal’aa tokko yaadi. Hogganaan guddaan tokko hawaasa waan qabatamaa qabachuuf hawwii guddaa qabu dhiisee Walgahii Waaqummaa wajjin godheera. Boqonnaa boqonnaa hin qabne sana keessatti namni amansiisaa tokko waadaa ifaa fi uumama qaroo lubbuu qabu fakkaatu qabate gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfata.
clues: Warra Muusaa waliin Gibxii bahan keessaa tokko ture, galaanni miliquuf gargar ba'uu isaa dhugaa ba'e.
Hogganaan keenya qajeelfama fudhachuuf halkan afurtama gaara yeroo deemu ilaaleen ture.
Faaya ummata irraa funaanee harka kootiin bocaa ture.
Re'ee sagalee gadi bu'u tokkon faashinii godhee, namoota itti waame.
Daandii ergamaa irraa dafqa harka muraasa fudhadhee waanan hojjedhe keessa darbadhe.
Muusaan wal dura dhaabbachuun 'na hin tuqin' jedhee adda ba'ee jiraachuuf balaaleffatame, walgahii murtiif waadaa seene.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
